title: How Showing Up Ten Minutes Early Builds a Godly Man People Count On
caption:
Being late doesn't feel like a character issue. Seven minutes, who cares. But every time you walk in late, you quietly teach people that your word bends.

Plan the night before. Leave for the slow lane, not the best case. Use the extra ten minutes in the parking lot to pray. Do it long enough and you become the man people don't have to wonder about.

"Let your yes be yes." Matthew 5:37

Save this for tomorrow morning.
